instruction.name: xvstelm.b
instruction.description: Store element `lane` of `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvstelm.b $xr0, $r20, 0, 0; xvstelm.b $xr1, $r20, 1, 0; xvstelm.b $xr2, $r20, 2, 0; xvstelm.b $xr3, $r20, 3, 0; xvstelm.b $xr4, $r20, 4, 0; xvstelm.b $xr5, $r20, 5, 0; xvstelm.b $xr6, $r20, 6, 0; xvstelm.b $xr7, $r20, 7, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024' --asm 'xvstelm.b $xr0, $r20, 0, 0; xvstelm.b $xr1, $r20, 1, 0; xvstelm.b $xr2, $r20, 2, 0; xvstelm.b $xr3, $r20, 3, 0; xvstelm.b $xr4, $r20, 4, 0; xvstelm.b $xr5, $r20, 5, 0; xvstelm.b $xr6, $r20, 6, 0; xvstelm.b $xr7, $r20, 7, 0'

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
